notes.status: UNAUDITED. Input of `btc_deploy.py token`. The contract is BridgedStablecoinV3, byte-identical (creation keccak 0xe560441f...1de7); only constructor arguments differ from bUSDC. It has 6 decimals: one unit is 100 sat.
notes.signers: TBD-owner: the 7 L2 mint signer addresses of the committee (the bUSDC inventory's l2-mint-signer keys), and the 3 L2 token guardian addresses.
notes.limits: Token units (1 BTC = 1,000,000 units). refillPerSecond is an integer: 1 unit a second is 0.0864 BTC a day, the lowest rate the contract can express.
